If you are passionate about transforming customer data, behavioral signals, and business priorities into connected, personalized customer experiences, this could be your next professional challenge. As Omnichannel Orchestration Lead, you will own the orchestration layer across channels, establishing the foundation for journey design, audience segmentation, decisioning logic, and personalization at scale through, while connecting Marketing, IT, and the wider business.

About the role

In 3Shape, we are looking for our new colleague to be the Omnichannel Orchestration Lead in our Omnichannel & Lifecycle team within Global Marketing.

In this role, you will take a central role in shaping how we orchestrate and personalize customer experiences across channels at scale. You will own the business operation and continuous optimization of our omnichannel orchestration capabilities, establishing the foundations that enable scalable customer engagement, including journey orchestration frameworks, decisioning logic, audience frameworks, and personalization capabilities.

You will work at the intersection of Marketing, Commercial, Data and IT, acting as the business lead and super user for our orchestration capabilities. You will translate business needs into functional requirements, drive adoption and best practices across the organization, and partner closely with IT to continuously evolve the capabilities and solutions that enable our omnichannel ambitions.

The role gives you a unique opportunity to combine strategic influence with hands-on orchestration and optimization, helping build and evolve the capabilities, frameworks, and ways of working that enable teams to turn customer data and technology into connected, relevant experiences that drive engagement and commercial growth. As our new colleague, you will be owning the business operation, development, and optimization of our omnichannel orchestration and personalization capabilities, turning customer data and commercial priorities into connected and personalized customer experiences at scale.

You will become part of a team of highly skilled and experienced colleagues driving omnichannel activation and lifecycle marketing globally. We foster a collaborative, ambitious and open environment, where testing, learning and continuous improvement are key to delivering stronger customer experiences and measurable business value.

The primary responsibilities are:

• 
Continuously evolve the technical foundation for omnichannel engagement including decisioning logic, triggers, and personalization rules across channels, and ensure their scalable implementation, optimization, and governance within the orchestration engine.

• 
Define and govern audience and segmentation frameworks to enable scalable and consistent customer activation

• 
Act as the business lead and super user for the omnichannel orchestration platform, driving adoption, optimization, and best practices

• 
Establish omnichannel governance and ways of working, ensuring global consistency while enabling regional execution

• 
Translate business needs into functional requirements for data, integrations, automation, reporting, and platform capabilities

• 
Partner closely with IT on solution design, development, testing, and implementation, acting as the bridge between Marketing and IT

• 
Define and prioritize the omnichannel capability roadmap and continuously strengthening the foundations that enable improved customer experiences and commercial performance.

Role and ideal profile:

You combine strategic thinking with hands-on experience building and optimizing the capabilities that enable omnichannel orchestration and personalization at scale. You understand how customer data, segmentation, automation, and decisioning create connected customer experiences and can translate business needs into scalable solutions.

You have hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM, CDP, or omnichannel platforms and effectively bridge Marketing, Commercial, Data, and IT. While not deeply technical, you have experience shaping and evolving omnichannel and MarTech capabilities to drive customer engagement and business value.

As a person you are proactive, structured, collaborative, and commercially minded, with strong stakeholder management skills and a focus on governance, testing, and continuous optimization.

We expect that you have:

• 
5+ years of experience within marketing technology, marketing automation, CRM, CDP, personalization, customer journey orchestration or a related field including experience working with MarTech ecosystems and integrations from a business or super-user perspective.

• 
Strong understanding of customer journey orchestration, segmentation, decisioning, personalization and customer data activation, having proven experience translating business needs into functional requirements, orchestration logic and scalable operational processes. Familiarity with platforms such as CRM, CDP, MA platform, Databricks and Azure is an advantage, but advanced technical expertise is not required.

• 
Experience evaluating and translating emerging AI capabilities into practical use cases, business requirements and roadmap priorities across omnichannel orchestration.

• 
Ability to translate omnichannel strategy into a prioritized capability and development roadmap together with Marketing and IT.

• 
Strong understanding of how customer data can be used to create relevant, coherent and personalized experiences across channels.

• 
Experience establishing governance, standards and ways of working across global and regional teams.

• 
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across Marketing, IT, commercial teams and regions.

• 
A commercially minded, structured and proactive profile who can connect business objectives, customer journeys, data and technology.

What 3Shape offers

• 
A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 20 nationalities in our DK-based office from all different backgrounds

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Good work/life balance.

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
Our purpose: We empower dental professionals to provide superior care for every patient, every time

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

About the job

We are one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies, and our customer portfolio is growing rapidly. Our ambitions go beyond payments: we keep launching new products in finance and admin for small and medium-sized businesses, starting with Capital, Banking and Online services. With more products across seven markets, soon eight, we need a strong marketing setup to deliver upsales, product adoption and churn prevention at scale.

Portfolio Marketing means marketing and sales activation toward our existing customers, to cross-sell, improve product adoption and prevent churn.

You will build this function. It is the first and most important hire in a new team, with 6-10 more hires planned over the next 12 months. Given the size of the portfolio and the pace of launches, the work looks more like an acquisition go-to-market than traditional lifecycle marketing.

You will report to the CMO and lead the Marketing Automation and Content teams dedicated to the portfolio. You will work closely with our specialists in media buying, creative performance and data & analytics. You will own a revenue target for the portfolio, together with our commercial organization.

What you'll do

• 
Start with the ambition. Translate our business goals into a portfolio marketing system, and build backwards from the revenue we need.

• 
Drive net dollar retention. Deliver upsales, product adoption and churn prevention at scale across all markets from day one.

• 
Launch products like an acquisition GTM. Plan and execute go-to-market motions for new products across the customer base.

• 
Build the team. Hire the Portfolio Marketing team across Marketing Automation and Content, and set the direction for both.

• 
Own the target. Set the portfolio revenue target together with the commercial organization, and report on what the portfolio delivers.

• 
Run it with performance discipline. Test, measure and scale what works. Use paid channels, creative and data where they outperform other levers.

• 
Align the stakeholders. Work with the CMO, the Chief Portfolio Officer and the Managing Directors in each market so that group priorities and local realities fit together.

Who you are

• 
You are highly commercial. You start with the business's ambitions and build the marketing system from there.

• 
You are well versed in performance marketing and comfortable owning a revenue target.

• 
You have built and led teams of at least 10 people, including leading other managers.

• 
You can turn data into a clear recommendation, and you present it with confidence to senior leaders and market MDs.

• 
You are curious. You ask why, test your assumptions and change your mind when the evidence says so.

• 
You are a builder. You are comfortable with speed and ambiguity, and with setting up structure where it doesn't exist yet.

• 
You communicate clearly in English.

Experience in portfolio, lifecycle or CRM marketing is not required, and neither is hands-on experience with automation platforms. You lead the motion and set the team up to deliver it.

At Flatpay, we believe in work-life balance, creativity, and a culture that embraces innovation, where our ambitious colleagues can thrive. As part of our team, you become a part of +2000 passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments in Europe.

Flatpay is proud to be a company that values diversity. We secure an inclusive work environment for all our people and offer opportunities for professional growth and development.

Are you passionate about IT, business, and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will specialise in banking and investment, collaborating with clients and experienced colleagues to design IT solutions and develop expertise in investment processes and corporate actions.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant with an interest in digitalisation and financial services to support initiatives within banking and investment. You will contribute to analysing business needs, mapping processes, and designing IT solutions in close collaboration with clients and colleagues. An interest in or basic knowledge of investment-related processes is an advantage.

You will join a team of highly experienced professionals who will support your continuous development towards a role as subject matter expert within IT solutions for banking and investment. Over time, you will build deep domain knowledge and develop into a go-to within banking and investment solutions.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Analysing clients' business needs and translating and formulating requirements into IT solutions within the banking and investment domain.

• 
Mapping business processes and facilitating workshops with clients to identify needs, challenges, and opportunities for optimisation.

• 
Supporting the analysis and design of solutions related to investment processes.

• 
Collaborating with experienced colleagues and clients on solution design, testing, refinement, and implementation, while supporting user involvement, training, and change management where relevant.

• 
Building domain knowledge through hands-on project experience and knowledge sharing, with the opportunity to develop into a subject matter expert over time.

About you

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how IT can support and improve them. Deadlines do not intimidate you, and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

• 
Are either a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, ideally working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly you are motivated to build specialized domain knowledge.

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it., or a similar degree with a focus on the intersection of finance and IT.

• 
Have a genuine interest in IT and digitalisation, preferably combined with an interest in finance, banking, investment, or financial services.

• 
Have an interest in or basic experience with investment-related processes, such as corporate actions. Previous experience within banking or investment is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**Purpose of role:

**nShift has a self-serve product purchase route into delivery management for small and midsize shippers. Customers find us online or through partners, start a trial, connect their shop and carriers, and move to a paid subscription without needing a traditional sales process.

In 2027, we want to turn that route into a measurable growth engine with a clear commercial return.

As Product-Led Growth Marketing Manager, you will own this growth stream end to end: the plan, funnel, budget, vendors and performance. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with experience who can set the strategy and execute it.

You will inherit an existing product, website, pricing model, onboarding journey, data and lessons from what has already been tried. Your job is to decide what comes next and build a repeatable model for growth.

**What you’ll be doing:

**

• Own the growth plan for self-serve, including target segments, markets, channel mix, budget, and commercial targets.

• Build and maintain the funnel model from website visit through signup, activation, paid conversion and retention, including acquisition cost, payback and conversion at each stage.

• Report on performance, identifying what is working, what needs to change, and where to invest next and act on the findings.

• Grow qualified traffic and trial signups through paid and organic search, ecommerce platform ecosystems, partnerships and other channels that reach small and midsize shippers.

• Set targets for paid media, manage external vendors, and make decisions on spend based on performance.

• Develop partnerships and co-marketing opportunities with ecommerce platforms, agencies, publishers and relevant communities.

• Own the self-serve website footprint as a conversion channel, including site structure, pricing, campaign landing pages, copy, proof and the signup journey.

• Run an ongoing experimentation program across acquisition, website conversion and signup, moving from hypothesis to test to decision.

• Work closely with Product to improve trial activation, onboarding and in-product guidance, and define the usage signals that show when a customer is reaching value.

• Build lifecycle communication from signup through paid conversion and expansion with the marketing automation team.

• Define the product events, properties and reporting needed to understand the funnel, working with Product and other teams to make that data usable across Marketing and Sales.

• Bring customer, market and funnel evidence into pricing and packaging decisions with Product and Finance, and test offers and trial variants against conversion and payback.

**About you:

**You are comfortable owning a commercial problem where not every answer has already been defined.

You can move between strategy and execution without losing sight of the number you are responsible for. You make decisions from evidence, communicate clearly when something is not working and change course when the data calls for it.

You are also comfortable working across functions. Success in this role depends on Product, Sales, Web, Finance, Support and Customer Success, but you will remain accountable for bringing those pieces together into a working growth model.

**What you will bring:

**

• Five or more years of experience in growth, performance or digital marketing in B2B software, including at least two years working with a self-serve or product-led funnel from trial or freemium to paid.

• Experience marketing to merchants using platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce or Magento, including app or partner ecosystems.

• Experience owning a growth target and budget, with clear examples of how you used performance data to change the plan.

• Strong understanding of funnel economics, including customer acquisition cost, conversion, retention and payback.

• Hands-on knowledge of GA4, Google Ads and at least one other major paid platform, with enough depth to manage and challenge an external agency or vendor.

• Experience improving websites and landing pages through testing, conversion analysis, and customer evidence. HubSpot CMS experience or equivalent is essential.

• A practical understanding of SEO, including search intent, page planning and content performance.

• Experience with lifecycle marketing and automation, including segmentation and triggered journeys.

• Experience working directly with product teams in areas such as signup, onboarding, in-product communication, pricing, or packaging.

• Strong written and spoken English.

**Nice to have:

**

• Experience in logistics, shipping, ecommerce infrastructure, or delivery software.

• Experience with at least one product analytics platform such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or PostHog, including event definition and cohort analysis

• Experience growing software products in the Nordic markets.

• HubSpot experience or certifications.

• Experience running pricing, packaging, offer or trial experiments.

Lead Consultant – Data Platforms & AI

• Full-time

• Office: Hellerup

Job Description

We’re looking for a data platform lead with a commercial mindset, ready to help our clients find out where AI fits and to play a central role in growing their business around it.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll advise clients on their data platform and AI choices, design the architectures, build them yourself, and lead the teams that deliver them. It’s a role that’s equal parts business-facing and technical: you’ll design and build on Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, and be just as at home in the client meeting.

Beyond the client work, you’ll team up with colleagues across The Tech Collective and Implement to spot opportunities, shape scopes, and help win the work. Having built these platforms makes you credible when you sell them, and selling them keeps you building what clients need. As the team grows, you’ll also help shape the offering itself: reference architectures, propositions, and people.

What you’ll bring

You’re a builder at heart. You have experience designing and delivering data platforms in at least one of Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and you can weigh them against each other. To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• 
A commercial mindset – you spot opportunities, shape scopes, contribute to proposals, and are comfortable in a room with senior business stakeholders

• 
Fluency in AI and how it depends on the data platform – from data foundations and governance to taking AI use cases into production

• 
Experience leading projects or engineering teams (e.g., as an engineering manager or tech lead) while staying close to the code

• 
Clear communication with both engineers and executives, and the ability to turn platform choices into business decisions

• 
A collaborative style – you develop the people around you and enjoy building something together with others

What we offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll be part of a team that blends nerdiness, energy, and a sincere interest in people. You’ll have influence over how we grow, close sparring with experienced peers, and the chance to shape the offering as it develops.

Our culture is built on high autonomy with responsibility, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing. You’ll work on projects across industries and disciplines – from strategy rooms to solution pilots with leading technologies. And to support your growth, we also provide internal training, keynotes, and hands-on learning across AI, data, cyber, and digital strategy.

How to apply

• 
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application ASAP

• 
Please apply with your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI, and analytics, ensuring that they are ready for what comes next.

Ready to shape the digital future with us?

jobs.description:
Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne

Har du interesse for vin, sans for godt værtskab og lyst til at gøre en forskel? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Le Petit Vinbar søger vi en eller to ekstraordinære kolleger til et lille, men stærkt internationalt team af engagerede mennesker, der brænder for at skabe oplevelser som gæsterne husker – og vender tilbage til.

Vi tilbyder op til 120 timer om måneden til en person eller ca. 60 timer hver til to personer. Vagterne ligger mellem kl. 9 og 21, både på hverdage og i weekender.

Godt værtskab er kernen i det, vi laver

Vi søger dig, der tager initiativ, har blik for detaljerne og møder mennesker med varme og nysgerrighed. Du lægger mærke til, hvad gæsterne har brug for, og gør dig umage for, at alle føler sig set, velkomne og godt taget hånd om – også når der er travlt.

Du har erfaring fra café, bar eller restaurant og trives med at tage ansvar. Du behøver ikke være faglært tjener eller vinekspert, men du er interesseret i vin og har lyst til at lære og dele din viden med gæsterne. Interesse for mad er også et plus. Du kan kommunikere med vores gæster på dansk eller engelsk.

Vi er et lille hold, hvor alle tager del i hverdagens opgaver: vinservering, gæsteservice, madlavning, opfyldning og oprydning. Vi hjælper hinanden og lægger vægt på både godt samarbejde og omhu i det daglige arbejde.

Om Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar er en lille, livlig vin- og champagnebar midt i Torvehallerne i København. Baren blev grundlagt i 2013 af Ole Mejlby og Sylvain Codron, og vi importerer selv vores vine direkte fra små producenter i Frankrig, Italien og Østrig.

Hos os mødes vininteresse og personligt værtskab. Vi deler gerne historierne bag vinene og hjælper gæsterne med at finde noget, de bliver glade for – uanset om de kommer for et enkelt glas eller en hel eftermiddag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med mulighed for at lære mere om vin, mad og service og sætte dit præg på gæsternes oplevelse.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os, om du søger ca. 60 eller op til 120 timer om måneden, og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette eller de rette kolleger. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Join the team at Le Petit Vinbar in Torvehallerne

Do you have an interest in wine, a flair for hospitality and a desire to make a difference? Then we’d love to hear from you.

At Le Petit Vinbar, we’re looking for one or two extraordinary colleagues to join our small but strong international team of dedicated people who are passionate about creating experiences that guests remember—and return for.

We offer up to 120 hours per month for one person, or approximately 60 hours each for two people. Shifts fall between 9 am and 9 pm, on both weekdays and weekends.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail and approaches people with warmth and curiosity. You notice what guests need and take care to make everyone feel seen, welcome and well looked after—even when it’s busy.

You have experience working in a café, bar or restaurant and enjoy taking responsibility. You don’t need to be a formally trained waiter or a wine expert, but you have an interest in wine and are keen to learn and share your knowledge with guests. An interest in food is also a plus. You can communicate with our guests in Danish or English.

We’re a small team where everyone contributes to the daily tasks: serving wine, looking after guests, preparing food, restocking and keeping things clean and tidy. We help each other and value teamwork and care in our everyday work.

About Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar is a small, lively wine and champagne bar in the heart of Torvehallerne in Copenhagen. Founded in 2013 by Ole Mejlby and Sylvain Codron, we import our wines directly from small producers in France, Italy and Austria.

Here, a love of wine meets personal hospitality. We enjoy sharing the stories behind our wines and helping guests find something they’ll love—whether they’re stopping by for a single glass or spending the whole afternoon with us.

You’ll join a dedicated team, with opportunities to learn more about wine, food and service, and to make your mark on our guests’ experience.

Practical information and how to apply

Salary and start date by agreement.

Send a short application and your CV to job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Tell us why you’d like to work with us, whether you’re looking for approximately 60 or up to 120 hours per month, and when you can start.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, and will hire once we’ve found the right person or people. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? Are you motivated by taking responsibility for the entire software development process and ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards?

If so, we might have the right job for you!

As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions while ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards. Moreover, you will contribute to the successful implementation of solutions by conducting training sessions for internal stakeholders and end users. You will support projects, collaborate closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO), and ensure valuable feedback from projects and site integration is used for adjustments and further development.

Responsibility for Vision and Robotics

We are a global organization, but you will be working from our office in Aarhus and be part of a small team of highly skilled colleagues in logistics. You will join the Robot Product Team, which covers multiple disciplines – Electrical, Mechanical, Automation – with you as the software responsible. You will work in close collaboration with the TPO, who acts as Product Owner, and you will have sparring opportunities with software colleagues across the organization to support knowledge sharing and development. Here, your responsibilities will be:

• Improving new software products related to vision and robotic applications and supporting their use in projects.

• Maintaining and developing software applications according to our operating model and applicable standards.

• Ensuring code quality through reviews, documentation, and adherence to coding and architectural guidelines.

• Offering input to automation strategy and technical requirements and setting product requirements in collaboration with the business.

• Testing and validating functionalities on our local test loop or on sites.

• Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams on a common system and evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies for automation and system integration.

Experienced Software Developer

You are familiar with commonly used tools, frameworks, and libraries relevant to 3D vision, point cloud processing, and AI development, and can evaluate and apply them effectively based on product needs. Additionally, we imagine that:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or an equivalent qualification in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

• You have solid proficiency developing real-time applications in C# and Python.

• You possess solid expertise in classical computer vision and 3D geometry, with a strong focus on point cloud processing and object recognition.

• Experience or interest in machine learning and signal processing is highly relevant, as these fields play an increasing role in advancing vision and robotics applications.

• You have experience in developing and maintaining various software architectures such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• You possess strong knowledge of software design principles, design patterns, and effort estimation for development tasks, and have hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), as well as software prototyping and conceptualization.

• You bring a solid understanding of high-level integration with robotic systems and can design and implement interfaces that enable effective communication between software components and robotic controls.

• You can combine input from multiple sensors into valuable insights. This could be cameras, LiDAR's, encoders, safety sensors etc.

Moreover, you demonstrate innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset. You bring excellent communication skills, team spirit, and a high willingness to learn. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Interested?

If you find the description interesting, please do not hesitate to contact Henning Horn Lauritsen +45 8741 4674 with any question you might have or apply via the link.

We look very much forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
The Center for Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position focusing on process simulation, techno-economic assessment, and optimization of large-scale Power-to-X (PtX) systems for the production of renewable fuels and chemicals. The preferred start date is February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Job Description

The PhD position is part of SDU Life Cycle Engineering's research activities on PtX technologies, renewable fuel production, sector coupling, and the transition toward climate-neutral energy systems.

PtX technologies are expected to play an important role in decarbonizing hard-to-abate sectors by converting renewable electricity into synthetic fuels, and chemicals. However, their large-scale deployment requires efficient process design, effective integration with local energy system and biomass availability, and economically competitive operation under variable renewable electricity supply and changing market conditions.

The PhD project aims to develop and apply advanced process simulation and techno-economic optimization frameworks for large-scale PtX systems. A central focus will be on linking detailed process simulations with techno-economic models to evaluate alternative process configurations, identify opportunities for sector coupling, and optimize technology capacities and operating conditions. The project will also investigate how electricity prices, renewable electricity availability, hydrogen, biogas and CO2 supply, and process flexibility influence the economic performance of industrial-scale PtX facilities. The research will combine process simulation tools, particularly Aspen Plus, with computational modelling and optimization approaches. 

The successful candidate will contribute to ongoing national and international research projects and collaborate with academic and industrial partners working on PtX technologies and sustainable energy systems.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE) at the University of Southern Denmark's main campus in Odense. 

SDU LCE is a rapidly expanding research center with a strong international profile in net-zero transitions and sustainable energy systems. The center conducts research on integrated energy system design, renewable energy integration, PtX technologies, carbon management, sustainable biomass utilization, sector coupling, and CCUS integration.

SDU LCE is actively engaged in national and international research projects supported by the EU, national innovation programs, private companies, and other organizations.

Within SDU LCE, the research group focusing on renewable fuel production, process integration, techno-economic assessment, and energy system optimization is experiencing significant growth. The group combines detailed process modelling with system-level analysis to address the technological and economic challenges associated with industrial decarbonization.

For more information about SDU LCE, please visit www.sdu.dk/lifecycle. 

 

Qualifications

Modelling of Power-to-X technologies.

Thermodynamic modelling, mass and energy balances, process design, and heat integration.

Techno-economic assessment, including capital and operating cost estimation, levelized production costs, and economic sensitivity analysis.

Programming and numerical optimization using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.

Understanding of renewable electricity integration, process flexibility, and sector coupling.

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an independent and curious research mindset, and an interest in interdisciplinary collaboration. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required.

 

Responsibilities

The successful PhD candidate will be expected to:

Develop detailed process simulation models of selected large-scale Power-to-X technologies and integrated production pathways.

• 
Perform thermodynamic analysis, mass and energy balances, and process integration assessments.

• 
Develop techno-economic models to estimate investment costs, operating costs, and levelized production costs of renewable fuels and chemicals.

• 
Apply optimization approaches to investigate process configurations, operating conditions, technology capacities, and economic performance.

jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Food Science programme. The position is available from 15 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Agroecological approaches to reduce nitrogen losses in vegetable production

Research area and project description
This PhD project will investigate how to reduce nitrogen losses from vegetable production systems. The aim is to successfully introduce and optimize mitigation measures such as catch crops, biomass removal, precision fertilization and irrigation in open field vegetable crop rotations to reduce residual soil N. The focus will be on losses by nitrate leaching as well as vegetable growth and nitrogen use efficiency. The aim is to optimize resource use and reduce environmental and climate impact of both organic and conventional vegetable systems using agroecological approaches. Relationships will be studied by experimental and modelling methodologies between soil nitrogen availability, crop nitrogen uptake and nitrate leaching losses based on soil water, soil and plant sampling from field trials at research and commercial fields. Investigations of losses of nitrous oxide may be included.

Research questions to be addressed include:
 
• How do crop traits influence the effectiveness of various mitigation measures in efficiently reducing nitrogen losses in organic and conventional vegetable production?
• How to optimize fertilization and irrigation practices for adequate root zone availability of nitrogen for high yielding and low nitrogen leaching vegetable production? 
Statistically designed field experiments will be available for studying mitigation measures on nitrate leaching in vegetable crop rotations at the research station AU-Auning. Fields at vegetable producers are equipped and available. The Department provides access to the state-of-the-art field and laboratory facilities. The PhD student will join the Science Team of Plant, Food and Sustainability, which includes PhD students and other scientific and technical staff. We foster a friendly and respectful working environment in an international atmosphere. We aim to collaborate and enjoy while contributing to the sustainability of food production.

The study will be conducted as part of Danish (Nvirkværk, GUDP) and European (Gound2Live, Agroecology Partnership, HEU) projects, which aim to: Integrate cover crops and other measures in sustainable vegetable cropping; Reduce losses of nitrate and nitrous oxide from intensive vegetable production; A Living Lab methodology is used in an agroecological framework, including European stakeholders from horticultural industries and universities.

Qualifications and specific competences
